participation.context: Wrote the fair page and left it on the board.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Had decided the wash. She was not in the room.
participation.name: Anne Shakespeare

story.body: You let the wash stand as she had set it, left the Christmas money as three uses without sums, and asked one ordinary question. You did not send the sheet.

title: Wrote Anne about the wash and the Christmas money

participation.context: Struck the line and did not attach it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You kept the annoyed sentence on a scrap, struck through, and you did not copy it onto the page that will go.

title: Struck the cold line on the scrap

participation.context: The square hand is hers. She was not in the room.
participation.name: Anne Shakespeare

story.body: You left her letter beside the page you had just written.
